# Public DSH attachment storage and codec

Twelve pure modules selected from [DSH d743267](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c). SOURCE.json records original paths/hashes and local adapted hashes. Adaptation changes import paths and `.ts` suffixes to NodeNext `.js` only. The root MIT LICENSE is retained. The authored contract.ts exports these pure modules without the supplier Cordis service owner. The build verifies the selected hashes.

Sharp is pinned separately at 0.35.5, matching this DSH baseline's minimum. Sharp/native wrappers retain Apache-2.0; the Linux libvips 1.3.4 wrapper declares LGPL-3.0-or-later. These dependencies are not relabeled MIT. The npm collector retains exact notices; release/attachment-native-linux-x64.json records native bytes and upstream reported linked versions. Complete linked source/notices/rebuild coverage remains a public binary release gate. See docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md for qualified scope, receipts and remaining work.
